item.title: Skan AI融资6300万美元，押注\"观察员工实际工作方式\"是企业AI缺失的关键层
item.summary: Skan AI, a startup that builds what it calls a "context graph of work" by observing how employees actually perform their jobs across enterprise software, has raised $63 million in Series C funding co-led by Cathay Innovation and Dell Technologies Capital, the company announced Wednesday.
